scope: Diagnosis only: exactly four previously failed Set F sequences, baseline and candidate; no policy changes or acceptance claim.
runner: Existing scripts.far_range_eval.run_sequence called unchanged; jobs reconstructed with original full RNG consumption/order, cache, stamps, speed intake, exact saved config, parameters. Only selected four jobs executed.
observer: External wrappers around Detector.process, Tracker.update, Tracker._note and Tracker._fresh_stop_ok delegate exactly once to original functions without modifying inputs or return. Snapshot every track/current cluster, provenance note, fresh predicate decision, near/approach/clean gauge/column/hold/withheld and final detections. Read-only derived predicates only.
acceptance: For each variant compare entire returned run_sequence dictionary to its archived sequence, with zero differences required; no fields excluded (sequence output has no wall/timing fields). Verify clean HEAD, detector source digest, effective config, local enabled native hash before and after. Retain any failure; do not reinterpret it as parity.
execution: At most one detector process, four sequences sequentially per variant; pause new work immediately when parent announces quiet runtime. No full gate/history run.
